graph.summary: Aspirin → Cyclooxygenase-1 → Thromboxane A2 → platelet aggregation → Myocardial Infarction

evidence.snippet: Aspirin works by irreversibly acetylating the cyclooxygenase (COX-1) enzyme, thus suppressing the production of thromboxane A(2) (TxA(2)) and inhibiting platelet activation and aggregation.
evidence.explanation: Directly states aspirin irreversibly acetylates COX-1, decreasing its activity.

paper.title: Clopidogrel and aspirin in cardiovascular medicine: responders or not--current best available evidence.
paper.journal: Cardiovascular & hematological agents in medicinal chemistry

evidence.snippet: Inactivation of platelet cyclooxygenase (COX)-1 by low-dose aspirin leads to long-lasting suppression of thromboxane (TX) A2 production and TXA2-mediated platelet activation and aggregation.
evidence.explanation: States that aspirin inactivates COX-1, confirming decreases activity of relationship.

paper.title: The Multifaceted Clinical Readouts of Platelet Inhibition by Low-Dose Aspirin.
paper.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

evidence.snippet: Cox-1 catalyzes the synthesis of thromboxane A2 (Tx-A2), which causes platelet activation, vasoconstriction, and smooth muscle proliferation.
evidence.explanation: Directly states COX-1 catalyzes synthesis of TXA2, establishing COX-1 positively regulates TXA2 production.

paper.title: Vascular biology of thrombosis: platelet-vessel wall interactions and aspirin effects.

evidence.snippet: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX) 1 involved in the platelet production of thromboxane (TX) A(2), an inducer of vasoconstriction and a platelet activating agent.
evidence.explanation: States COX-1 is involved in platelet production of TXA2, supporting positive regulation.

paper.title: [Variable platelet response to aspirin and new therapeutic targets].

evidence.snippet: Thromboxane A2 (TXA2) is implicated in graft failure by inducing vasoconstriction and platelet aggregation.
evidence.explanation: Directly states TXA2 induces platelet aggregation, supporting positive regulation.

paper.title: Mechanism of thromboxane receptor-induced vasoconstriction in human saphenous vein.

evidence.snippet: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX) 1 involved in the platelet production of thromboxane (TX) A(2), an inducer of vasoconstriction and a platelet activating agent.
evidence.explanation: Describes TXA2 as a platelet activating agent, supporting its role in positively regulating platelet aggregation.

paper.title: [Variable platelet response to aspirin and new therapeutic targets].

evidence.snippet: Excessive aggregation of platelets at the site of plaque rupture on the coronary artery led to the formation of thrombus which is reported to precipitate acute myocardial infarction (AMI).
evidence.explanation: Directly states platelet aggregation at plaque rupture precipitates acute myocardial infarction.

paper.title: Reduction of death rate due to acute myocardial infarction in subjects with cancers through systemic restoration of impaired nitric oxide.
